name: Community — Krea 2 Finetunes
author: Stable Yogi / Felldude / Binyuan / Adel_AI
description: Four trained Krea 2 checkpoints, as opposed to the merges in the Krea 2 pack — each with a specific, tested purpose. Muse v3.5 Extended: clean SFW editorial portraits with a real 8-20 step / CFG 1-3 range (ships 12 steps / CFG 1.5). FinalCut v2: matte skin instead of Krea 2's glossy 'wet skin', native up to 2432x1920, NSFW-capable. Binyuan Portrait v3.2: East Asian portrait realism trained on ~1,000 unedited studio photos. Kreamania V8: Adel_AI's refinement of Krea 2 for volumetric light and matte skin, NSFW intact. All four render at native ~2 MP with an Upscale slider (1.1-2x) that adds a gated 4-step detail-refine pass. They share the Qwen3VL 4B encoder and Qwen-Image VAE with the Krea 2 pack, so each preset costs only its 12.8-14.5 GB checkpoint.

presets.name: Muse Krea 2 v3.5 Extended
presets.tagline: Clean editorial portraits with a real quality dial
presets.description: Stable Yogi's Muse v3.5 Extended — the most-downloaded Krea 2 checkpoint on Civitai, tuned for clean SFW editorial portraits, fashion and lifestyle characters. 'Extended' means it holds together across 8-20 steps and CFG 1-3 instead of being pinned to one turbo setting. Ships at 12 steps / CFG 1.5: natural pores and freckles without crunch. 8 steps CFG 1 is softer and 2x faster; the author's 16 steps / CFG 2 went over-baked and HDR-crunchy in our test, so treat CFG 2+ as a punch dial, not a default. Renders at native ~2 MP; the Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail-refine pass, verified clean at 1.5x.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models, fp8 scaled, 12.83 GB, SHA256 840EE6A7…) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, negative zeroed. SFW editorial mix. CFG above 1 runs a real negative pass, so per-step cost doubles. Measured 2026-09-01 on a 4070 Ti at 1408x1408: 8 st/CFG 1 ~24 s, 12 st/CFG 1.5 ~59 s, 16 st/CFG 2 ~78 s (all incl. model load); Upscale 1.5 to 2112x2112 adds ~30 s. Upscale >1 adds a lanczos resize plus a 4-step denoise-0.1 refine pass gated by ComfyMathExpression + ComfySwitchNode so Upscale 1 is a clean single pass. Author says do not exceed CFG 3.

presets.name: FinalCut Krea 2 Massive Update (INT8)
presets.tagline: Matte skin, no Krea gloss; native up to 2432x1920
presets.description: Felldude's FinalCut for Krea 2, now the "Massive Update" release (Comfy_Quant_V3, INT8, 2026-09-11), which replaced the v2 file this card shipped with; CivitAI removed v2, so 1.1.0's download 404s and this 1.2.0 points at the successor. Same idea as before: a trained Krea 2 finetune (hundreds of hours), not a merge, built to kill Krea 2's glossy 'wet skin'. Our v2 side-by-side held that claim: matte skin and cooler, softer light where Moody and Realia show sheen. NSFW-capable, SFW fine. Graph unchanged: euler/simple, 8 steps, CFG 1, native ~2 MP; the Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail-refine pass. The Massive Update file has not been re-baked here yet; settings carry over from v2.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models, INT8 Comfy_Quant_V3, 13.8 GB, SHA256 17910207…) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Successor to the withdrawn v2 file; v2 timings (1408x1408 ~27 s, 2432x1920 ~66 s on a 4070 Ti) are expected to carry over but are not re-measured on this file.

presets.name: Binyuan Krea 2 Portrait v3.2
presets.tagline: East Asian portrait realism, trained on unedited photos
presets.description: Binyuan's Krea 2 Portrait v3.2 — the official Turbo finetuned on ~1,000 unedited studio photographs of East Asian women. The only checkpoint in the pack aimed at East Asian faces, and in our studio test it gave the most photographic result of the three tried: natural features, matte skin, convincing hair, where Moody went waxy. It reads lighting words literally (a 'softbox' in the prompt got drawn into the frame), so describe light quality rather than gear. v3.2 is the author's stable release; v4.x are marked experimental by the author. SFW-oriented. Renders at native ~2 MP; the Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail-refine pass, verified clean at 1.5x.

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models, INT8, 12.83 GB, SHA256 32644A1D…) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Portrait finetune on the official Turbo. Measured 2026-09-01 on a 4070 Ti: 1408x1408 ~23 s incl. load, 1216x1632 ~18 s; Upscale 1.5 to 2112x2112 ~49 s. Upscale >1 adds a lanczos resize plus a 4-step denoise-0.1 refine pass gated by ComfyMathExpression + ComfySwitchNode so Upscale 1 is a clean single pass.

presets.name: Kreamania Krea 2 V8 (fp8)
presets.tagline: Adel_AI refine: volumetric light, matte skin, NSFW intact
presets.description: Adel_AI's Kreamania Variant 8 — a refinement trained directly on Krea 2 (not derived from the earlier Kreamania variants, and not a merge). The author's two goals for V8 are rebalanced, more volumetric lighting and a real reduction of Krea 2's 'wet/damp skin', with NSFW rendering left intact. Both hold in our test: matte, freckled skin under raking window light, and dust and mist that actually read as volume, in ~55 s on a 4070 Ti at 1216x1632. fp8 build (the author also offers INT8 ConvRot and mxfp8 at the same size). Ships at the author's 10 steps / CFG 1 on euler/simple; the author's own samples use heunpp2/sgm_uniform, which costs about twice per step if you want to try it. One honest caveat from the author: a random artifact has persisted since V7 and a different seed clears it. Trigger word 'Bradhamel art style' is trained in for the illustrated look; leave it out for photos. Renders at native ~2 MP; the Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a 4-step detail-refine pass (same gated chain as FinalCut).

requirements.notes: Krea-2 DiT (diffusion_models, fp8, 12.82 GB, SHA256 C9265985…, Civitai model 2729631 / version 3292830 / fileId 3184832) + Qwen3VL 4B encoder + Qwen-Image VAE. euler/simple, 10 steps, CFG 1, negative zeroed. Trained refinement of Krea 2 by Adel_AI; NSFW-capable. Measured 2026-09-09 on a 4070 Ti: 1216x1632 ~55 s and 1888x1056 ~52 s, both incl. model load (vram 10.7/12 GB free at launch). Workflow is byte-identical to finalcut-krea2-v2-int8 apart from the SaveImage prefix, so the Upscale >1 lanczos + 4-step denoise-0.1 refine gate (ComfyMathExpression + ComfySwitchNode) is the already-verified chain; Upscale 1 is a clean single pass.
